common.comingSoon: This section is built in a later phase.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: An unexpected error occurred. Reloading the page should let you continue.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address does not exist, or it has changed.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.body: Your account is not permitted to view this page. If you think this is a mistake, contact your teacher.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.body: You need to set a new password before continuing.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter the email and password your teacher gave you.
login.failed: Could not sign in. Please try again.
login.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in is not available right now.
login.googleFailed: Google sign-in did not work. Please try again.
login.noSignup: Accounts are created by your teacher. If you have a class code, use the join link they sent you.
login.panelBlurb: An English practice platform built for your class.

join.title: Join a class
join.subtitle: Enter the class code your teacher sent you.
join.codeHint: 8 characters, for example K7M3-P9QR. Case does not matter.
join.googleExplainer: Your account will be created with Google. We only use your name and email.
join.failed: Could not join the class. Please try again.

errors.incomplete: The class code needs all 8 characters.

classDetail.noActiveCode: This class is not open for joining by code.
classDetail.shownOnce: Shown once only. Copy it now.
classDetail.qrAlt: QR code linking to the class join page
classDetail.rotateToReveal: Only a hashed copy is stored. Create a new code if you need to send it again.
classDetail.rotateConfirmTitle: Create a new code for this class?
classDetail.rotateConfirmBody: The old code stops working immediately. Students who already joined stay in the class.
classDetail.rotateFailed: Could not create a new code. Please try again.
classDetail.revokeFailed: Could not stop joining. Please try again.
classDetail.noMembers: No students in this class yet.
classDetail.name: Student
classDetail.removeKeepsWork: Removing a student only revokes access. Their work is kept.
classDetail.expiredExplainer: This code has expired, so students can no longer use it. Create a new one.
classDetail.copyFailed: Could not copy. You can select and copy the link manually.
classDetail.removeFailed: Could not remove the student. Please try again.
classDetail.membersFailed: Could not load the student list. Please reload the page.
classDetail.revokeConfirmTitle: Stop accepting joins for this class?
classDetail.revokeConfirmBody: The current code stops working immediately and no new one replaces it. Students who already joined stay in the class.
classDetail.removeConfirmTitle: Remove this student from the class?
classDetail.removeConfirmBody: They lose access to this class immediately. Their work is kept.

settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
settings.noPassword: This account signs in with Google and has no password.
settings.googleOnlyExplainer: Google is currently the only way into this account. Set a password before unlinking.

media.chooseFile: Choose a file from your device
media.deleteBlocked: This file is used by a published test and cannot be deleted.
media.deleteConfirmBody: It will be removed from the library. Published tests keep working.
media.dropHere: Drag a file here, or click to choose one
media.dropHint: mp3 and m4a only, up to 10 MB and 5 minutes
media.empty: No files yet. Upload your first listening file to get started.
media.loadFailed: Could not load the media library.
media.rejectDuration: {{name}} is {{duration}}, over the 5 minute limit. Please trim it.
media.rejectSize: {{name}} is {{size}}, over the 10 MB limit. Please compress or trim it.
media.rejectType: {{name}} is not an mp3 or m4a. Only those two are accepted.
media.title: Media library
media.rejectFolder: No file arrived. If you dragged a folder, open it and drag the files themselves.
media.rejectMany: One file at a time. Please drag them one by one.

questionEditor.autoGraded: This question is graded automatically. Only short answers need manual grading.
questionEditor.blanksHint: Mark blanks in the question text with {{'{{1}}'}}, {{'{{2}}'}}
questionEditor.explanationHint: — shown after submit, if the assignment allows it
questionEditor.manualGraded: Short answers need you to grade them after the student submits.
questionEditor.mediaHint: mp3 or m4a · up to 10 MB · 5 minutes
questionEditor.optionsHint: Select the radio to mark the correct answer
questionEditor.placeholderMissingBlank: The question text has {{list}} but no matching blank.
questionEditor.placeholderUnreferenced: Blank {{list}} has no matching marker in the question text.
questionEditor.sampleAnswerHint: — only you see this, for grading
questionEditor.transcriptPlaceholder: Paste the transcript here. Students see it only if the switch above is on.
questionEditor.loadFailed: The question could not be loaded.
questionEditor.saveFailed: The question could not be saved.

errors.twoOptions: At least two options are needed.
errors.answerRequired: A blank still has no accepted answer.
errors.placeholderMismatch: The blank markers do not match.
